_doc: Named waivers for scripts/check-chain-step-status.mjs — chain steps that resolve to a NON-LIVE node. This file is REQUIRED: deleting it makes the gate RED, not quiet (SO #34c). Every waiver needs an owner_row and a reason of at least 40 characters. The ratchet runs one way: `--prune` removes waivers that no longer name an offender, and there is deliberately no --update, so a NEW offender can only be waived by a human typing a reason here.

waivers.reason: Pre-existing on main when this gate shipped. art-99 was deprecated by PR #1477 and is the ENTRY step of mica-transitional, so find_chain advertises route_mica_transitional_deadline as callable while the worker registers node tools live-only. Resolving it means re-stepping the chain around art-99 or retiring the chain, both STRUCTURAL chain modifications and therefore a human ASSEMBLE/LAND decision (ruling 48). GENERATOR-STATUS-FILTER-1's fence forbids touching chaingraph.json by hand, so this gate ships baselined rather than redding main on a condition it may not fix. ART99-GHOST-CLEANUP-1 (PR #1501) kept the page as a retirement stub and preserved the URL for a rebuilt successor; if that successor lands live under the same tool_id, this waiver becomes stale and --prune removes it.
